name: Izz Noland
headline: Senior DevOps Engineer / Site Reliability Engineer
summary: Senior DevOps Engineer and Site Reliability Expert with 20 years of experience managing large-scale cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes platforms, and Infrastructure as Code.
Proven track record delivering measurable business impact including $100k+ monthly cost savings through automation, reliability engineering, and platform optimization across AWS and GCP.

experience.title: Senior DevOps Engineer, SRE Core
experience.summary: Led infrastructure strategy and SRE practices for a large-scale gaming and sports betting platform supporting millions of concurrent users.
bullets: Led infrastructure strategy for 100+ Kubernetes clusters across GKE and Anthos, supporting high-availability gaming platforms.
Delivered $100K+/month in cost savings through event-driven scaling, HPA implementation, and fleet-wide resource right-sizing.
Championed SRE practices as Data Vertical lead: prod-mirror environments, fault tolerance testing, and support workflows adopted across teams.
Served as Kubernetes SME and second-highest code contributor to ephemeral environment platform, mentoring engineers on Go, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, and Helm.
Architected a Terraform-first modernization strategy, migrating from Terragrunt to Terraform Cloud while maintaining legacy systems.
Reduced deployment time from hours to minutes through CI/CD and deployment automation improvements.

experience.title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer
experience.summary: Platform engineer focused on migrating container workloads and codifying infrastructure at scale.
bullets: Primary contributor migrating containerized workloads from GKE to AWS EKS, reducing infrastructure costs by over 30%.
Built all infrastructure using a Terraform-first approach, ensuring every system was codified, documented, and reproducible.
Enabled platform reliability through standardized networking, IAM, and Kubernetes patterns.

experience.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
experience.summary: Platform engineer improving CI/CD and Kubernetes reliability on AWS.
bullets: Built CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, Terraform, and Docker for Amazon EKS.
Migrated Jenkins from EC2 to Kubernetes using Terraform, Helm, and Groovy for configuration as code.
Improved deployment reliability and repeatability through GitOps patterns.

experience.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
experience.summary: SRE on the Observability team building internal tooling and migrating services to GCP.
bullets: Built in-house observability tooling using Go, Python, YAML, and jsonnet.
Owned Specter and Lookout monitoring applications ensuring coverage of normal and edge cases.
Assisted migration of microservices from AWS to GCP, cutting infrastructure costs by over 20%.

experience.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer

Supported PCI, SOC1, and SOC2 compliance initiatives.
